info.title: Banking & Finance API
info.description: A comprehensive API for banking management including accounts and transactions. This API adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance requirements. All monetary amounts are handled in minor units (e.g., cents) or with explicit currency codes.
